summary.markdown: I am an associate professor of biostatistics at Northbridge University. I develop methods for **causal inference** with electronic health records and registries.

body.html:
My group works on target trial emulation, missing data in registries, and Bayesian models for small areas. We share code and synthetic data with every paper.

Before Northbridge I was a postdoctoral fellow at the Lakeshore Cancer Institute. I completed my PhD in biostatistics at the University of Lakeshore in 2019.

I am recruiting PhD students for fall 2027. Read the research page first, then email me.
